# PLOS Biology

Production-ready main-article figures for PLOS Biology; supporting-information figures follow separate requirements.

## Rules

| Rule ID | Strength | Phases | Probe | Assertion |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `figure.width.min` | required | live, file | `artifact.width_mm` | gte `66.8` mm |
| `figure.width.max` | required | live, file | `artifact.width_mm` | lte `190.5` mm |
| `figure.width.text-column` | recommended | live, file | `artifact.width_mm` | approx `132` mm |
| `figure.width.full` | required | live, file | `artifact.width_mm` | approx `190.5` mm |
| `figure.max_height` | required | live, file | `artifact.height_mm` | lte `222.3` mm |
| `export.formats.main` | required | file | `artifact.format` | in `tiff, eps` |
| `raster.resolution.range` | required | file | `artifact.dpi` | between `300.0, 600.0` dpi |
| `artifact.file_size.max` | required | file | `artifact.file_size` | lte `10000000` B |
| `font.family` | required | live | `font.families.effective` | subset `Arial, Times, Symbol` |
| `font.size.min` | required | live | `font.size.min_pt` | gte `8` pt |
| `font.size.max` | required | live | `font.size.max_pt` | lte `12` pt |
| `figure.title.prohibited` | required | live | `figure.has_title` | eq `False` |
| `raster.color_mode.allowed` | required | file | `raster.mode` | in `RGB, L` |
| `raster.compression.required` | required | file | `raster.compression` | eq `lzw` |
| `raster.pages.max` | required | file | `artifact.page_count` | lte `1` page |
| `file.naming.fig_sequence` | required | bundle | `metadata.filename.compliant` | eq `True` |

## Caveats

- Initial submissions may embed figures in a manuscript PDF; these rules target individual revised or production figure files.
- Supporting-information figures are outside this profile's scope.
